## Description {#details}

Deferred reporter class template for a specific expression.

<ParametersList title="Template Parameters">
<ParametersListItem name="Expr_T">The type of the expression being reported.</ParametersListItem>
</ParametersList>
The <code><a href="/micro-test-plus-xpack/docs/api/classes/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus/detail/deferred-reporter">deferred&#95;reporter</a></code> class template extends <code><a href="/micro-test-plus-xpack/docs/api/classes/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus/detail/deferred-reporter-base">deferred&#95;reporter&#95;base</a></code> to provide deferred reporting functionality for a specific test expression within the framework.

This class template is responsible for capturing the expression under evaluation, the abort status, and the source location. It is intended exclusively for internal use and is implemented in the <code>include/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus</code> folder to ensure a structured and modular codebase.

Constructs a deferred reporter for a specific expression.

<ParametersList title="Parameters">
<ParametersListItem name="expr">The expression under evaluation.</ParametersListItem>
<ParametersListItem name="abort">Indicates whether reporting should abort further processing.</ParametersListItem>
<ParametersListItem name="location">The source location relevant to the report.</ParametersListItem>
</ParametersList>
Initialises the reporter with the given expression, abort status, and source location.

This constructor initialises a deferred reporter for a specific expression, capturing the evaluation result, abort status, and source location.

The expression is evaluated and its boolean result is passed to the base class. The abort flag determines whether further test execution should be halted if the expectation fails. The source location provides contextual information for reporting purposes.

## Public Destructor

### ~deferred&#95;reporter() {#aa221de23c9bed6bc5844c077fbafa46b}

<MemberDefinition
  template={<>template &lt;class Expr&#95;T&gt;</>}
  prototype={<>micro&#95;os&#95;plus::micro&#95;test&#95;plus::detail::deferred&#95;reporter&lt; Expr&#95;T &gt;::~deferred&#95;reporter ()</>}>
Destructor for the deferred reporter.

The destructor finalises the deferred reporting process for a test expression. If the evaluated expression is true, the reporter records a successful outcome along with any accumulated message. If the expression is false, the reporter records a failure, including the abort status, message, and source location for comprehensive reporting.

This mechanism ensures that all relevant information about the test outcome is captured and reported accurately when the deferred reporter goes out of scope.

<MemberDefinition

Appends a message to the reporter.

<ParametersList title="Template Parameters">
<ParametersListItem name="T">The type of the message to append.</ParametersListItem>
</ParametersList>

<ParametersList title="Parameters">
<ParametersListItem name="msg">The message to append.</ParametersListItem>
</ParametersList>

<SectionUser title="Returns">
Reference to the current reporter instance.
</SectionUser>

This operator overload enables the deferred reporter to accumulate expectation messages by appending the provided value to the internal message string.

If the argument is of an arithmetic type, it is first converted to a string using <code>std::to&#95;string</code> before being appended. For all other types, the value is appended directly. This ensures that both numeric and string-like messages are handled appropriately and consistently.
